# Volume 3 timeline

## Chapter I The Shadow of Change

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her impending departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in the orchard before walking to the Post Office. On her way home, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her on the bridge and tries to express his deeper feelings, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cuts the moment short. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts and talks with young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) about her plans and growing up.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

## Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they are presented with gifts before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves for college. The next evening, after feeling discouraged by well-meaning neighbors, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk through the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), where they find a wild apple tree and enjoy a peaceful stroll together.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P7](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0007), [v3 ch.Autumn P32](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0032)_

## Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after saying emotional goodbyes to her family and friends. She travels by boat and train alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie, eventually arriving in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) where [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) greets her and takes her to their new boarding house.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010)_

## Chapter IV April’s Lady

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feel dwarfed by their new environment. Later in the afternoon, they explore Old St. John's Cemetery, where they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a vibrant student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) who instantly befriends them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P12](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0012), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats lightly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her undecided romantic life between [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), her family, and her reluctance to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After discovering an old war grave in the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects emotionally on history before she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discuss Philippa's surprisingly endearing character.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Lady P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 ch.Lady P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069)_

## Chapter V Letters from Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as the Freshmen class wins the annual Arts Rush under Gilbert's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly befriends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them to her broad social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a batch of comforting letters from home, including updates from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

## Chapter VI In the Park

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for an autumn walk through the park and into town. As they linger, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss life, sorrrow, and happiness while taking in the sunset. On their way home, the group discovers a charming old house called Patty's Place on [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) instantly feels connected to.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P21](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0021), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032), [v3 ch.Park P40](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0040)_

## Chapter VII Home Again

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After completing their first-term examinations at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) heads to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is joyfully welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and the twins, later helping little [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) resolve his guilt over wanting to say a bad word. Over [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from Miss Lavendar, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

## Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on behalf of her brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) while staying the night in Anne's room. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promptly rejects the awkward proxy proposal, leaving [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) somewhat offended and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflecting on how unromantic her very first marriage proposal turned out to be.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P10](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0010), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P28](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0028)_

## Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — During her second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) contends with unwanted romantic attentions from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), whom she turns down. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a proposal from her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) to rent a house together for the next school year, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a search that ends with a sign on Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_

## Chapter X Patty’s Place

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Afterward, back at their lodgings, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) begs and receives permission to join their household at Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

## Chapter XI The Round of Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes, including Ruby Gillis's failing health due to illness. On their way to visit Ruby, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stop by to see the sharp-tongued [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md). Later, they visit the Gillis house, where Ruby tries to hide her illness under a facade of gaiety.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 ch.Life P52](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0052)_

## Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) works on writing her story, "Averil's Atonement," sharing her drafts with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and receiving blunt critiques from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After sending the completed manuscript to two different magazines and receiving rejections from both, a disheartened [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to lock the story away and abandon her literary ambitions.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P28](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0028), [v3 ch.Atonement” P41](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0041), [v3 ch.Atonement” P60](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0060), [v3 ch.Atonement” P67](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0067)_

## Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Tommy](../character/tommy.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md)** — Rebellious against Mrs. Lynde's rules, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerces [Dora](../character/dora.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and playing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). Afterwards, he lies to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to cover up his behavior, but he is tormented by guilt until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home that night and listens to his confession.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v3 ch.Transgressors P56](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0056), [v3 ch.Transgressors P93](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0093)_

## Chapter XIV The Summons

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a quiet evening with [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully admits her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her as best she can, and the conversation deeply affects her view of life. Shortly after, Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the community to mourn her at her funeral.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 ch.Summons P14](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0014), [v3 ch.Summons P29](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0029), [v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) about a baking powder story contest, only to be horrified when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reveals she edited and submitted Anne's story 'Averil's Atonement,' winning the prize. Although distraught over her work being turned into an advertisement, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is somewhat comforted when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) offers a practical perspective on the matter.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P4](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0004), [v3 ch.Down P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022), [v3 ch.Down P35](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0035)_

## Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), decorating the house and taking in pets. After an unsuccessful attempt to chloroform a stray cat, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formally adopts [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who joins [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) in their new home.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) shares her easygoing approach to chaperoning the girls at Patty's Place. Meanwhile, her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), settle in, with the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) quickly asserting dominance over [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) while [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) engage in ongoing battles before eventually becoming close friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

## Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) returns home to the girls' cozy cottage with snow-covered boots and news on butter prices. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads a humorous letter from young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), detailing his recent school composition and various happenings back home.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Davy P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Davy P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006)_

## Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays, which are dampened by severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and worries about her college finances. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) engages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in amusing chatter until Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail. Among the letters, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that Miss Josephine Barry has died and left her a thousand dollars in her will.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P21](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0021), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

## Chapter XIX An Interlude

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — On her twentieth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on growing up in conversation with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) comes downstairs dressed for a dance and chats playfully about her suitors and appearance before departing.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Interlude P35](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0035)_

## Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat inside Patty's Place before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steps outside into the orchard. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) heartbroken and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upset over the loss of their friendship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P36](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0036)_

## Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant fortnight in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), where she visits her birthplace and explores her parents' old home. The current occupant gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a bundle of old love letters written by her parents. After visiting their graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads the letters at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly) and feels truly connected to her parents for the first time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P12](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0012), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is reminiscing at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unexpectedly arrives home a day early from college. They embrace and chat about her walk home, after which [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) arrives and eagerly tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his lost tooth, his adventures, and his future marriage plans.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gables P4](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0004), [v3 ch.Gables P5](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0005), [v3 ch.Gables P11](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0011), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)_

## Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends her summer vacation in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), feeling a quiet loneliness over her strained friendship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys visits with [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss Lavendar, though [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) realizes he is growing too old for his childhood imaginary friends, and Miss Lavendar cautions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) were meant for each other.

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 ch.People P15](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0015), [v3 ch.People P31](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0031)_

## Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

**[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — In a letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) written from [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) describes her summer boarders and recounts her growing affection for [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), a theological student who preaches a moving sermon.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — After discussing her options with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk in the park to clear her head. When a sudden rainstorm ruins her umbrella, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student returning to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). The two take shelter in a pavilion and walk back to Patty's Place together, after which [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a box of roses, sparking romantic excitement.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P11](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0011), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041)_

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), feeling unusually off-kilter, and immediately notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room with Christine.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — While studying for examinations at Patty's Place, the girls learn they can stay for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) go for a walk in the park, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals that [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md) proposed to her and she accepted.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007), [v3 ch.Confidences P14](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0014), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019)_

## Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carson](../character/carson.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while helping comfort [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about his weekend schoolwork. They discuss local village funerals, gossip, and Diana's upcoming wedding. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting mournfully on changing friendships and growing up.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Evening P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000), [v3 ch.Evening P7](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0007), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 ch.Evening P24](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0024)_

## Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their deep friendship. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) marries [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), after which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, talking about their summer plans and how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) is changing.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P16](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0016), [v3 ch.Wedding P19](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0019)_

## Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Skinner](../character/skinner.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and gets a lift to her boarding house from Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), the local mail carrier. Along the way, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) regales [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with the story of her recent marriage to [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) over a wealthier suitor, emphasizing the importance of love over riches. They eventually arrive at Janet's place, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), where Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) leaves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a warning about the local marsh.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_

## Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Esther](../character/esther.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to Philippa describing her new boarding place at 'Wayside' with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She discusses the house, Janet's cooking, the awkward hired boy [Sam](../character/sam.md), and mentions an ongoing elderly love affair in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

## Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Janet](../character/janet.md) to a prayer meeting in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where she meets [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), Janet's quiet admirer. The next day, John invites them both to his house for tea so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can meet his elderly mother. During the visit, Mrs. Douglas treats [Janet](../character/janet.md) politely while making light comments about her impending death and John's eventual marriage, leaving John looking visibly tortured.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)_

## Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md)** — [Janet](../character/janet.md) tearfully confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) has been visiting her for twenty years without proposing. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to take a firm stand, [Janet](../character/janet.md) sharply rejects John's escort after prayer-meeting, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) immediately regrets her advice upon seeing John's heartbreak and rushes to reconcile them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Coming” P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 ch.Coming” P17](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0017), [v3 ch.Coming” P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023), [v3 ch.Coming” P27](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0027)_

## Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md)** — During her time in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). After John Douglas's mother passes away, [Alec](../character/alec.md) fetches [Janet](../character/janet.md), and John soon arrives to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his mother forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying or telling anyone.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_

## Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and unpack while catching up with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cheer themselves up during a rainy evening by reading old, overly tragic stories written during their [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her stories, delighting her and the household. Later, while out on a walk with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns his family plans to visit Patty's Place on Saturday. However, Roy's mother and sisters arrive unexpectedly on Friday while the household is unprepared, leading to an awkward visit featuring rambunctious cats and a flattened chocolate cake.

## Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — As examinations finish and graduation arrives, the girls at Patty's Place reflect on what they have learned from their college experience. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's flowers over Roy's. Later, after hearing a rumor of Gilbert's engagement to Christine, she breaks her pink heart chain in secret distress and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_

## Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — As the housemates pack up Patty's Place and reflect on their [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) years, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) out to propose to her. Although everyone expects [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to accept, she realizes in the moment that she does not truly love him and refuses his proposal. A devastated [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home and confesses what happened to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who scolds her at first before offering comfort.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P0](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0000), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_

## Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), who has just given birth to her baby boy, little [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md). Joined by Mrs. Allan, they talk about motherhood and childhood memories, which leaves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feeling lonely and disconnected as she walks home alone.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 ch.Weddings P43](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0043), [v3 ch.Weddings P45](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0045), [v3 ch.Weddings P51](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0051)_

## Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is devastated to learn that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is gravely ill with typhoid fever. During a painful night of vigil, she comes to the sudden realization that she loves [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and always has. The next morning, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) delivers the joyous news that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P27](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0027)_

## Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes a walk through the autumn woods to Hester Gray's garden, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts for the following afternoon. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) confesses his enduring love for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and asks her to marry him, clearing up past misunderstandings about [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happily accepts, and they walk home together engaged.
